name: Warpriest Signifer Battlepriest
body:
A good number of hellknight signifers are priests, but the duty of a hellknight calls them to the frontline of combat often. The signifer battlepriest blends their divine studies with martial prowess which exemplifies the divine signifer.

Alignment: A signifer battlepriest must be lawfully-aligned.

Catechesis (Ex)

At 1st level, a signifer battlepriest is given some training in the religious aspects of the hellknights which gives them a hardened mind and body. The signifer battlepriest gains Warrior Priest as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

This ability replaces focus weapon.

Order (Ex)

A signifer battlepriest must join an order of hellknights.

Discern Lies (Sp)

At 3rd level, a signifer battlepriest can use discern lies as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 3 plus their Wisdom modifier.

Their caster level is equal to their class level. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 3rd level.

Signifer Mask (Ex)

At 6th level, a signifer battlepriest has earned the right to bear their signifer mask. They must pass the test and kill a devil single handedly before getting their mask. Once they do, they receive a signifer mask which grants the signifer battlepriest a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks and on saves against visual effects.

Additionally, the signifer mask can be used once per day to cast any one spell that the signifer battlepriest has access to from the domains available to their deity or faith, or the law domain, and is capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by the signifer battlepriest, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on the signifer warpriest’s level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities.

The signifer battlepriest can add special abilities to their signifer mask as any other wondrous item as if they have the Craft Wondrous Item feat, so long as they meet the level requirements of the feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 6th level.

Assiduous Gaze (Su/Sp)

At 9th level and again at 15th level, a signifer battlepriest gains an assiduous gaze ability chosen from the list on page 12. A signifer battlepriest can use each assiduous gaze ability they possess for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 their class level. These rounds need not be consecutive.

A signifer battlepriest can activate an assiduous gaze ability as a swift action to examine a single creature, object, or 5-foot square within 30 feet. A signifer battlepriest must be wearing their signifer mask to use these abilities, and their caster level while using them is equal to their class level.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 9th and 15th levels.

Infernal Resilience (Ex)

At 12th level, a signifer battlepriest gains DR 5/chaotic and becomes immune to poison. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 12th level.

Diabolic Harbinger (Su)

At 20th level, as long as the signifer battlepriest wears their signifer mask, they gain telepathy with a range of 100 feet, and can see perfectly in both magical and mundane darkness. While wearing their signifer mask, they are immune to blindness and dazzling effects and gains a +2 bonus on all Charismabased checks when interacting with lawful creatures.

This bonus increases to +4 if the creature is also an outsider. This ability replaces avatar of war.
